title: alyssum montanum subvar. molliusculum
intro: Alyssum montanum subvar. molliusculum, commonly known as Alpine Sweet Alyssum, is a small, delicate flowering plant in the Brassicaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Sweet Alyssum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
